blocks.orig: The Kili Seasons is located just outside Arusha, near the Usa River and close to an amazingly beautiful golf course. The hotel offers 16 spacious double rooms (some of which can be connected to form family rooms) with air conditioning, WiFi, an indoor sitting area, a veranda, a comfortable bathroom and views over either the pool, garden, the nearby Usa River or, weather permitting, Mount Meru. Upon arrival, you can take a refreshing dive in the swimming pool or relax at the so-called Kili Beach along the Usa River. Golf lovers can visit the golf course that offers spectacular views of Mount Meru and Mount Kilimanjaro, and – if you are lucky – some very unusual golf partners in the form of zebras and antelopes.
blocks.html: Just outside Arusha, by the Usa River and near a very beautiful golf course, you find Kili Seasons. The hotel has 16 spacious double rooms (some can be joined to create family rooms), each with air conditioning, WiFi, an indoor seating area, a veranda, a comfortable bathroom and a view of the pool, the garden, the nearby Usa River or, when the weather allows, Mount Meru. When you arrive, you can cool off with a swim in the pool or relax on the so-called Kili Beach beside the Usa River. If you enjoy golf, the course has spectacular views of Mount Meru and Mount Kilimanjaro and – with a bit of luck – some rather unusual playing partners: zebras and antelopes.
